zones.name: West Approach Woods
zones.description: Player Start at (40, 175) on the western wooded approach overlooking the highway road; natural rock and tree cover leading up to the outer bridge security cordon, patrolled by E1 Grunts and E10 Scouts.

zones.name: North Ridge Overwatch & Sniper Perch
zones.description: High northern hillside running parallel to the bridge with watchpoints and ruined concrete facades (env_building_facade_a) where Ghillie Sniper M05_E6_01 (410, 285) overlooks the bridge approach, protected by Tripwire Alarm M05_T1_01 and Directional Mine M05_T3_01.

zones.name: Bridge Approaches & Under-Bridge Catwalks
zones.description: Riverbank slopes and maintenance catwalks running underneath the main bridge deck (env_vent_shaft_2m & service walkways), featuring Environmental Hazards M05_T16_01 (520, 165) and M05_T16_02 (680, 165).

zones.name: Main Bridge Span & Fortified Checkpoint
zones.description: 500m-long concrete highway bridge (env_wall_concrete_4m barriers, sandbag emplacements, and toll/checkpoint booths at (600, 175)), monitored by 4 Security Cameras (M05_CAM_01 to M05_CAM_04 linked to M05_MON_01 — S1), where 2 Cargo Trucks (veh_truck_cargo_a crewed by 2x E13) halt for 90s during convoy event (O1), covered by Ghillie Sniper M05_E6_02 (645, 195) on bridge gantry tower.

zones.name: South-East Garrison & Captain Dar's Command Compound
zones.description: Fortified concrete command building ([820, 40] to [960, 120]) with elevator/stairs, 3 interior rooms (R1, R2, R3), Tripwire M05_T1_02, Directional Mine M05_T3_02, and Alarm Panel M05_ALM_01; Boss Captain Dar (M05_E14_01) commands from this sector, protected by 4x E4 Cobalt Elite guards and carrying Dar's Briefcase (S2).

zones.name: East Riverbank Extraction
zones.description: Eastern highway exit and wooded trail leading to the Extraction Point at (1160, 320) (radius 10.0m).

primary.title: Sabotage convoy (plant & detonate C4 on both cargo trucks) & eliminate Captain Dar

secondary.title: Disable all 4 checkpoint cameras via monitor M05_MON_01
Steal Captain Dar's briefcase without raising Alert 3 (Ghost Medal)

extraction.title: Extract at East Riverbank Extraction Point (1160, 320)

events.description: At elapsed >= 360s, the 2 cargo trucks drive onto the bridge and stop at the central checkpoint (600, 175) for 90s so the player can plant C4 on both trucks.
At elapsed >= 900s, an enemy patrol helicopter (veh_helicopter_enemy_a) arrives and sweeps the bridge with a high-intensity searchlight.

silent.name: Silent Route (Under-Bridge Catwalk Infiltration, Maintenance Ladder C4 & Suppressed Assassination)
silent.description: Infiltrate from West Approach Woods (40, 175) down to the under-bridge catwalks (320, 165), bypass T16 hazards to the maintenance ladder behind the checkpoint (585, 165), climb up to plant C4 on both convoy trucks at (600, 175), slip into Zone E Command Building (890, 80) to assassinate Captain Dar with a suppressed weapon & take his briefcase, and extract at (1160, 320).

technical.name: Technical Route (Checkpoint Monitor Hack M05_MON_01, EMP Convoy Escort & Side Door Unlock)
technical.description: Advance from (40, 175) to the West Bridge Gate (350, 175), hack checkpoint camera terminal M05_MON_01 at (600, 175) to disable all 4 cameras (S1) and use an EMP grenade on the convoy escort while planting C4, descend the South-East ramp (780, 110) to unlock the Command Building side door into (890, 80) to eliminate Captain Dar, and extract at (1160, 320).

loud.name: Loud Route (North Ridge Counter-Snipe, Convoy C4 Ambush & Garrison Storm)
loud.description: Ascend from (40, 175) to the North Ridge Sniper Perch (410, 285) to counter-snipe E6 Ghillie Snipers, ambush the convoy at the central bridge checkpoint (600, 175) with C4 and rifle fire, breach the North Garrison gate (890, 140) to storm Captain Dar's command post at (890, 80), and extract at (1160, 320).
